tier_rule: I54 incremental: original preregistered witnesses only; each scope 1% unless both formal phases demonstrate witness lower CI >=1/0.95. Decimal pretrial speed is not used to relax old/typed witnesses. C16/F0 same corresponding frozen witness rule. Always report both 1% and 5% classifications.
formula: ratio=reference/new; cost=100*(1/ratio-1). P iff lower CI>=1/(1+guard); R iff upper CI<1/(1+guard); else U. Coverage/quality required first; estimates are not worst latency.

sampling.cluster: whole true process cycle retaining both orders

controls: same bc2 control; normalized short/long <=5%; full factory887; normal GC and timed allocations/destruction retained; no startup gc adjustment

local_recovery.scope: only incomplete quality or CI-straddling guard scenarios selected by the frozen rule, not speed; retain original results
local_recovery.rule: same protocol additions keep all qualified clusters; changed calls/target require new controls plus complete main/ind replacement for fixed affected scene set; max one call-length change and two true-process extensions after initial per-scene recovery; no unchanged rerun after cap
local_recovery.exit: stop invalid configuration on original 10 consecutive quality rejects; diagnose only fixed gap and use no more than preauthorized recovery; local cap never stops independent scopes; final40min delivery retained

cost_forecast_correction.basis: historical final-c16 checkpoint each main/independent 32min; typed each3.6min; current calibration observed context; no performance result used to change protocol
cost_forecast_correction.source: S02 releases85min after explicit F01 approved upstream boundary
